If you are interested on getting started on homebrewing I would start off by finding a good home brew store and get a basic starter kit. For starting off you don't need to much more than the basic bre kit and a stainless steel brewing pot. Basic brewing kits usually contains a 5 gall bottling bucket, 6 gall fermenting bucket, a fermentation lock, transfer tubing, abottle filler, a bottle capper, a bottle brush, a hydrometer and sometimes one beer making kit. If they don't refer to the list above and but them individually. You are going to want to also get a sanitizer to soak your beer equipment in before starting. You don't want stray yeast or bacteria in the are or surfaces of your suplies getting in your brew. When starting off i would suggest starting with a beer or wine kit and expanding from there with more experience. Homebrewing can be a fun hobby if done right. Please post you beginning endeavor in your homebrewing experience.
